title: FAQ: Green Account (savings)
summary: FAQ for Rho-Bank’s Green Account (savings) states the account earns 4.0% APY, requires a $500 minimum balance (no monthly maintenance fee if missed), and can receive a +0.5% APY bonus when paired with an EcoCard or Green Rewards Card. It also notes Rho-Bank matches donations to partner environmental charities at 50% and instructs customers to confirm current APY/bonuses in online or mobile banking.
